statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-29869 affects Apache Hive hive-exec 2.3.10 used by Spark. The vulnerability involves insecure file permissions on temporary credentials files. The fix is available in Hive 4.0.1, but Spark 4.0.x and 4.1.x depend on Hive 2.3.x for compatibility with the Spark Hive metastore integration. Upgrading from Hive 2.3.10 to 4.0.1 represents a major version jump that would require extensive testing and validation by Apache Spark upstream to ensure compatibility with Spark's Hive integration layer.
